headline: Toshiba reports a reduced-order mixed-signal model for automotive heat and electromagnetic-interference verification
fact: Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage published an automotive verification case using its Accu-ROM reduced-order modeling method to derive a VHDL-AMS model from SPICE behavior for an electric-power-steering system. Toshiba reports reducing the reference simulation from 32 hours 51 minutes to 3 hours 27 minutes while reproducing the compared motor-current, temperature, and electromagnetic-interference behavior.

sources.title: Toshiba Develops Mixed-Signal Simulation Technology for Automotive Semiconductors
sources.summary: Toshiba's September 2021 announcement describes its Accu-ROM mixed-signal simulation technology and automotive application.

sources.title: Fast Mixed-Signal Simulation Technology Using Reduced-Order Modeling
sources.summary: Toshiba's technical review documents the VHDL-AMS reduced-order model, electric-power-steering case, timing comparison, and correlated behaviors.
